intent: Calm a surface that overstimulates, by removing emphasis rather than shrinking it.
moves: Count the elements competing for first attention. Keep one, demote the rest a full step.
Replace filled backgrounds with borders wherever the fill was decorative.
Cut the number of distinct font weights on the surface to two.
Move colour off surfaces and onto the one element that needs the eye.
Halve every animation duration, then ask whether the motion is needed at all.
avoid: Reducing everything proportionally, which preserves the noise at a smaller size.
Lowering text contrast to soften the look — quiet is not the same as unreadable.
Replacing colour with grey while keeping the same number of competing elements.
